New distinct fail-open family: Story, checklist, user-visible, and verification-intent leaves are classified independently, so a causal dismissal relationship split across leaves is admitted even though the assembled Task Context publishes the complete unsafe authority claim.

F-011 preserves a different dismissal-receipt authority witness plus the observation that protectedAnchors and fileRules are also rendered, but its demonstrated trigger is the same omitted scope.explicitExcludes leaf and the same manual source-inventory defect canonically captured by F-010.

Independent family: crossSourceNegativeDismissalAuthority combines an earlier negative observation with a later conclusion even when that conclusion has its own unrelated local causal antecedent. The deterministic-cache then Accordingly-cleanup witness is a false positive and is neither the direct/coreferent omission nor an active-voice observation bypass.

Independent family: a direct or coreferent conclusion in a later structured leaf, such as It is out of scope, bypasses the cross-source authority check because the implementation requires an explicit causal token. This differs from F-012 because there is no unrelated local antecedent, and from same-leaf linkage failures.

Independent family: the negative-observation recognizer is limited to passive forms, so active-voice statements such as This intake closes no parent Finding and The intake does not close any parent Finding escape before their ownership or scope conclusions are evaluated.

Duplicate of F-013: both demonstrate the same missing direct/coreferent cross-leaf linkage caused by requiring TRIAGE_CAUSAL_LINK. F-015 preserves additional witnesses for The work is outside this Story and It is out of scope in the explicitExcludes scope leaf, but those witness and noun-target differences do not create a separate mechanism.

Independent family: the same-leaf scan treats any later ordinary exclusion as a conclusion of the earlier negative-dismissal observation solely because of ordering, without causal language or coreference. The generated-cache exclusion witnesses and reversed-order controls distinguish this local all-remaining-segments false positive from F-012 cross-leaf local-antecedent joining.

Duplicate of F-016: both exercise segments.slice(index + 1).some(isLinkedResponsibilityConclusion) joining an unrelated later exclusion inside the same source leaf. F-017 preserves the explicit Separately topic-break witness, but it does not identify a different implementation mechanism.

Independent family: controlled-pair polarity treats the presence of any negation token as safe rather than composing negation parity, so not not and cannot not affirmative dismissal conclusions bypass the guard while the single-negative control remains safe. This is the inverse fail-open of the earlier single-negation false-positive family.

Independent family: rendered user-authorable structural strings such as relatedDocs anchors, checklist file values, protected files, and file-rule values receive neither authority scanning nor a closed structural grammar, allowing forbidden authority text to reach the prompt. This differs from F-010/F-011 natural-language scope-leaf omission because the implicated leaves are structurally named and require either exhaustive scanning or mechanical shape enforcement.

Independent family: negative-dismissal recognition is hard-coded to the determiner no and singular Finding is-style agreement, so equivalent not-a-single and zero/plural propositions diverge into false-positive and fail-open outcomes. This is distinct from F-014 active-voice observation shape and F-005 modifier or word-order limits because the passive proposition retains canonical ordering and fails on quantifier and number agreement.

Independent family: verificationIntent is included in authority scanning, but a leading Inject or Mutate verb plus a trailing failure assertion exempts the entire multi-sentence leaf as meta-safe, laundering unrelated authority text in the middle. This is distinct from F-019, where structural leaves are omitted from scanning entirely, and the before/after outcome controls isolate the blanket whole-leaf exemption.
